name: The Kase of Heaven
source:
Kasey Leroy ran away from his abusive father to live on his own. However, his life turned upside down when he ran into several good-looking guys who were hosts in Club Heaven. Kasey decided to join the club after being persuaded by Wolfheim, the number one host of the club. Kasey has to pass the test and choose a mentor.

[From [url=http://kynezksou.deviantart.com/art/TKOH-VN-Game-Download-459041543]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
凯西·勒罗伊逃离了虐待他的父亲，独自生活。然而，当他遇到了几个在天堂俱乐部担任主持人的帅哥后，他的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。凯西在俱乐部第一主持人沃尔夫海姆的说服下决定加入俱乐部。凯西必须通过测试并选择一位导师。
